name: Customer & Organization Registration
notes:
The self-service form of `ADM-380`, for a prospect with no account. Decided 11 September 2026; P09 keeps its screen for the operator-led path (BL-165). `tools/applied/apply-subscription-placement.py` keeps the two in step.

**Defined 4 October 2026 from StartProspectSignupRequest, VerifyProspectSignupCodeRequest and OnboardingApplication (companyName, contactEmail, contactPhone, countryCode, billingEntity)** (CHG-FXS-001)
purpose: Create the initial customer account and organization profile.
patternReason: Three steps on one form: prove the email, then the organisation, then submit (defined 4 October 2026 from OnboardingApplication, CHG-FXS-001).

components.label: One-time code
components.notes: Six digits; five attempts, then a new code is needed.

components.label: Verify code
components.notes: On success the organisation fields unlock; the verified email becomes contactEmail and is not editable.

components.label: Contact email
components.notes: The verified email, read-only.

components.label: Contact phone
components.notes: E.164, +971 by default.

components.label: Country
components.notes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; AE by default.

components.label: Legal name
components.notes: Optional here; required before the first invoice.

components.label: Trade licence number
components.notes: Optional here.

components.label: Tax registration number (TRN)
components.notes: Optional; 15 digits for a UAE VAT registrant.

components.label: Submit
components.notes: Sends a client UUIDv7 id and status submitted. The venue type and the plan are chosen in the next steps (venueTypeTemplateId and requestedPlanId are optional here).

components.label: Cancel
components.notes: Leaves without submitting; nothing is sent.

states.loading: Not used: the form renders at once.
states.error: The call that failed is named beside its button (code, verify or submit); what was typed stays.
states.emptyFirstRun: No customer organization registration yet. Carries the create action; distinct from a filter that matched nothing.
states.emptyNoResults: The filter narrowed it and the customer organization registration are still there. Names the active filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `TENANT_CONFIGURE`, which `submitOnboardingApplication` requires to show this screen, and names that permission. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data* and sends somebody to support with the wrong question.
